definition: The task of maintaining an accurate representation of the current state of a conversation, including user goals and previously provided information, across multiple dialogue turns.
details: Dialogue state tracking was central to earlier task-oriented dialogue systems (like booking assistants), helping ensure the system correctly remembers and acts on information provided across a multi-turn conversation.
story: Picture a translator at the United Nations, listening to one language and whispering the meaning into another in real time. Here is the short version: The task of maintaining an accurate representation of the current state of a conversation, including user goals and previously provided information, across multiple dialogue turns. The part that makes it sing: Dialogue state tracking was central to earlier task-oriented dialogue systems (like booking assistants), helping ensure the system correctly remembers and acts on information provided across a multi-turn conversation. Meaning lives in company — a word is known by the words it keeps. And that is Dialogue State Tracking — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
